glosses: to cosign: to sign a document prepared for a decision maker in order to indicate to them that one has read it and agrees

examples.text: Alle Abteilungsleiter müssen mitzeichnen, bevor der Entwurf dem Vorstand vorgelegt wird.
examples.translation: All heads of department have to cosign before the draft is presented to the manager.
examples.english: All heads of department have to cosign before the draft is presented to the manager.

examples.text: Alle Kinder zeichneten, nur Peter wollte nicht mitzeichnen.
examples.translation: All children were drawing, only Peter didn’t want to draw along.
examples.english: All children were drawing, only Peter didn’t want to draw along.
